blocks.raw: <Tip>Memorize the distinction: Positive-side = applied on water source surface (exterior below-grade, roof deck). Negative-side = applied on interior (low moisture only). Tropical climates always demand positive-side for hydrostatic. Polyurethane cures in damp conditions; acrylic requires dry substrate.</Tip>
